correctness.rationale: The proof reduces arbitrary binary qubit effects to projections by convexity/extreme points, reduces projectors to the trine plane by an even-convex radial argument, solves Bob's conditional trine discrimination through the exact Helstrom dual, treats both possible active-set regimes, and proves monotonic decrease away from the maximizing symmetry direction. The maximizing branch priors and radical are recomputed directly. Finite checks corroborate but do not replace the continuum proof.
